body.label: Effect
body.html: Establish a Standard within 2 units. Until your next turn, the first ally to begin an Action within 2 units becomes Rallied after that Action resolves.

surges.html: If an affected ally is already Rallied, it gains +1 Defense until its next turn instead.
Remove Dazed, Concussed, or Shocked from one affected ally.

rider.title: STANDARD — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority when an enemy enters your Standard's area: 1–3 it suffers -1 Defense; 4–5 it becomes Exposed; 6+ it becomes Exposed and cannot make Reactions until its turn.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
